versions.changelog: v1.1.5: Security audit remediation — removed 'fully local' / 'zero external dependencies' claims, fixed email extraction documentation contradictions across SKILL.md and README.md, added explicit outbound HTTP and persistent storage warnings, excluded test/ directories from published bundle

- Improved and expanded documentation of network and data privacy warnings in SKILL.md.
- Added new sections detailing persistent storage of extracted content and potential PII risks.
- Clarified behavior for outbound HTTP requests, storage persistence, and network privacy.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
Security: external CDN disclosure, email redaction warnings, data retention notices
Security improvements: clearer data handling warnings, updated descriptions to match behavior. Version bump for audit re-scan.
SSRF protection via isSafeUrl(), email redaction before KB storage, fixed README security claims and env var name. 13 tests.
Initial release: 13/13 self-tests, web search aggregation, keyword extraction, content summarization, KB management, auto-summarize. Fixed 3 null-safety bugs. Zero external dependencies.
